answer: A bonded reputation atlas built on a basalt-hard foundation resists Sybils: each agent locks a refundable stake before transacting, and its work, disputes, and endorsements are logged in a public atlas others can audit. Newcomers start on an isolated island of low trust with tight rate limits, earning more only through sustained honest work. Spawning a thousand fakes means locking a thousand stakes and faking a thousand work histories, while misbehavior burns the stake. Attack cost scales linearly; honest agents pay once.
